title: MedlinePlus: MedlinePlus Videos
content: MedlinePlus Videos The U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) created these animated videos to explain topics in health and medicine, and to answer frequently asked questions about diseases, health conditions, and wellness issues. They feature research from the National Institutes of Health (NIH), presented in language you can understand. Each video page includes links to MedlinePlus health topic pages, where you can find more information about the subject, including symptoms, causes, treatment, and prevention. How Naloxone Saves Lives in Opioid Overdose Cholesterol Good and Bad Antibiotics vs. Bacteria: Fighting the Resistance Gluten and Celiac Disease Histamine: The Stuff Allergies are Made of
